info.title: Hertwill Public API
info.description:
Public API for Hertwill dropshipping platform. Discover products, manage your import list, and sync products to your store.

## Authentication

**Public endpoints** (product discovery) require no authentication.

**Authenticated endpoints** (import list, sync) require a store-scoped API key:
```
Authorization: Bearer hw_live_...
```

Create API keys via the web dashboard or the `/v1/api-keys` endpoint (requires JWT login).

## Rate Limits

- Public endpoints: 60 requests/minute per IP
- Authenticated endpoints: 300 requests/minute per API key

Rate limit information is included in responses via the `RateLimit` and `RateLimit-Policy` headers (draft-8 combined format).

post.description:
Trigger sync of a product from your import list to your connected store (Shopify/WooCommerce).
The product must already be in your import list.

**Prerequisites:**
- Your store must have a Shopify or WooCommerce integration connected. Set one up at [hertwill.com/account/integration](https://hertwill.com/account/integration).
- Your store must not have reached its product sync capacity. If you hit the limit, upgrade your plan at [hertwill.com/account/plans](https://hertwill.com/account/plans).

403.description: Sync not allowed — store has reached its product sync limit. Upgrade your plan at hertwill.com/account/plans.

404.description: Product not found, or product not in import list — add it via POST /v1/import-list/products first.

422.description:
Validation error. Possible causes:
- No store platform connected — connect at hertwill.com/account/integration.
- Variations are required but not provided for a product with variants.
